answer_quote: Yes — that's correct. The specimen is being displayed from the posterior aspect, and the cord has been opened (cut longitudinally) so that its internal contents (the vessel(s)/tissue within the cord) are exposed, which is the glossy red opened tract running along the right side of the specimen.
note: 后侧开放结构与图像大致相符，但把开放的胎儿神经组织说明为切开后露出的“血管/绳索内容物”不符实际解剖，解释错误。
